# Mary Joe

## Overview

- **Origin:** French (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P3](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0003)</sub>  
  _previously: the creek (v1)_  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Mary Joe is a buxom [French](../codex/factions.md#french) girl. She is also characterized by her broad face.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028)_

## Personality

Mary Joe is described as a silly and ignorant girl. Though she is not naturally unreasonable, her past experiences have taught her never to disobey her grandmother's orders.

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P10](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0010), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P15](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0015)_

## Traits

- ignorant (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P15](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0015)</sub>
- not a naturally unreasonable person (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P10](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0010)</sub>
- silly (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P15](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0015)</sub>

## History

Mary Joe was a person whose absence left [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) Barry's parents away when [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) contracted a severe case of croup. Her situation required [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to seek help at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to nurse [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) through the night.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)_

## Relationships

### [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grandma-irving--mary-joe.md)

Mary Joe serves under [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md) as her employer. In this role, Mary Joe receives and carries out orders given by [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md).

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P10](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0010)_
